---
title: "DAUNPAPUA sampling database"
author: "Eric Pante"
date: "2026-04-29"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: false
resources:
  - data/
  - photos/
  - scripts/app.js
  - scripts/create_isobaths.R
sidebar: false
---

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet-draw/dist/leaflet.draw.css" />

<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet-draw/dist/leaflet.draw.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet-providers@1.13.0/leaflet-providers.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<div id="filters" class="filter-panel">
  <div class="filter-row">
    <label for="minDepth">Depth</label>
    <input id="minDepth" type="number" value="0" onchange="filterStations()">
    <span>Min</span>
    <input id="maxDepth" type="number" value="10000" onchange="filterStations()">
    <span>Max</span>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-row">
    <label for="toolFilter">Tool</label>
    <select id="toolFilter" onchange="filterStations()">
      <option value="all">All tools</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-row">
    <label for="dateFilter">Date</label>
    <select id="dateFilter" onchange="filterStations()">
      <option value="all">All dates</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-row">
    <label for="keywordFilter">Keyword</label>
    <input id="keywordFilter" type="search" placeholder="e.g. coral, sponge" oninput="filterStations()">
  </div>
  <p class="filter-note"><b>Keyword search:</b> uses the <code>caption</code> field from <code>photos.csv</code>. Enter several keywords separated by commas, semicolons, or spaces; a station is kept only if all keywords are found in its photo captions.</p>

  <div class="filter-row">
    <label for="photoFilter">Photos</label>
    <select id="photoFilter" onchange="filterStations()">
      <option value="all">All stations</option>
      <option value="available">Photos available</option>
      <option value="not_available">No photos</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-row">
    <label for="stationSearch">Station</label>
    <input id="stationSearch" type="search" placeholder="e.g. DW5521" oninput="filterStations()">
  </div>

  <div class="filter-row filter-actions">
    <button onclick="resetPolygon()">Clear polygon</button>
    <button onclick="resetFilters()">Reset filters</button>
  </div>
</div>

<p><b>Polygon selection:</b> use the polygon or rectangle tool on the map to restrict results to stations inside the selected area.</p>
<p><b>Bathymetry:</b> optional isobaths (100m to 1000m every 50m, data from GEBCO2026, parsed with marmap) are loaded from <code>data/isobaths.geojson</code>. Generate this file with <code>scripts/create_isobaths.R</code>.</p>

<div id="map" style="height: 500px; margin-top: 1em;"></div>

<h2>Results <span id="resultCount"></span></h2>

<div class="results-controls">
  <span><b>View:</b></span>
  <label><input type="radio" name="resultView" value="gallery" onchange="renderResults(currentFilteredStations)"> Gallery</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="resultView" value="table" checked onchange="renderResults(currentFilteredStations)"> Table</label>
  <button onclick="exportFilteredCSV()">Export filtered results to CSV</button>
</div>

<div id="results"></div>

<script src="scripts/app.js"></script>

<style>
/* Use almost the full browser width and keep equal left/right margins. */
#quarto-content {
  display: block !important;
}

.page-columns {
  display: block !important;
  max-width: none !important;
}

main.content,
#quarto-document-content {
  max-width: 90vw !important;
  width: 90vw !important;
  margin-left: auto !important;
  margin-right: auto !important;
}

.page-columns .content {
  grid-column: auto !important;
}

.filter-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.7em;
  padding: 1em;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 1em;
}

.filter-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5em;
  align-items: center;
}

.filter-row label {
  flex: 0 0 90px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.filter-panel input,
.filter-panel select,
.filter-panel button {
  padding: 0.35em 0.5em;
}

.filter-row input[type="number"] {
  width: 110px;
}

.filter-row input[type="search"],
.filter-row select {
  min-width: 240px;
}

.filter-note {
  margin: -0.2em 0 0 90px;
  font-size: 0.9em;
  color: #555;
}

.filter-actions {
  padding-left: 90px;
}

.results-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1em;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 0.8em 0 1em 0;
}

.results-controls button {
  padding: 0.35em 0.5em;
}

.results-table-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-top: 1em;
}

.results-table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  width: 100%;
  font-size: 0.9em;
}

.results-table th,
.results-table td {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  padding: 0.45em 0.6em;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.results-table th {
  background: #f5f5f5;
  text-align: left;
}

.station-card {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  padding: 1em;
  margin: 1em 0;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.photo-gallery {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}

.photo-gallery figure {
  width: 180px;
  margin: 0;
}

.photo-gallery img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 130px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
}
</style>
```
